Item.Name: TEST_ID
Item.Hint: Enter a test ID or use [LISTVAL].

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 x VARCHAR2(1) := NULL;
begin
 nullchk;
 begin
 select test_id, test_desc
 into :test_id, :s_test_desc
 from valid_tests
 where test_id = :test_id and
 (test_group in ('RHBAT','ROUAG','AG') or
 test_id in ('CMV','DAT')) and
 sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error('1227');
 end;
--
 if :system.record_status in ('NEW','INSERT')
 then
 begin
 select 'x' into x
 from fr_vrarity_matrix_det
 where matrix_id = :fr_vrarity_matrix_det.matrix_id
 and test_id = :fr_vrarity_matrix_det.test_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null;
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
 if x = 'x'
 then
 show_error ('0069');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 test_string VARCHAR2(2000):='';
 curr_string VARCHAR2(2000):='';
 cursor c1 is
 select test_id||'-'||test_result||':' test
 from fr_vrarity_matrix_det
 where matrix_id = :ctrl_block_1.matrix_id
 order by test_id;
 cursor c2 is
 select matrix_id
 from fr_vrarity_matrix_hdr
 where matrix_id != :ctrl_block_1.matrix_id;
 cursor c3 (p_matrix_id number) is
 select test_id||'-'||test_result||':' test
 from fr_vrarity_matrix_det
 where matrix_id = p_matrix_id
 order by test_id;
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 if :ctrl_block_1.matrix_id is null
 then
 begin
 select matrix_seq.nextval into :ctrl_block_1.matrix_id
 from dual;
 end;
 begin
 insert into fr_vrarity_matrix_hdr
 (matrix_id, rarity_percent, eff_date,
 term_date, last_modified_date, program_id)
 values
 (:ctrl_block_1.matrix_id, :ctrl_block_1.rarity_percent, sysdate,
 '',sysdate, 'MANUAL');
 end;
 end if;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 post;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 --
 for c1_rec in c1
 loop
 test_string := test_string||c1_rec.test;
 end loop;
 --
 for c2_rec in c2
 loop
 --
 curr_string := '';
 for c3_rec in c3(c2_rec.matrix_id)
 loop
 curr_string := curr_string||c3_rec.test;
 end loop;
 --
 if curr_string = test_string
 then
 show_error('1519');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end loop;
 --
 -- commit;
 check_pass; -- Added by Edwin on 12.12.2001 
 clear_form(no_validate);
 execute_trigger('PRE-FORM');
 go_block('CTRL_BLOCK_1');
end;

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLOCK__MATRIX_ID_LOV0
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
SELECT
 rmd.matrix_id,
 LISTAGG(rmd.test_id
 || decode(mc.code_type, 'REAC', '+', '-'),
 ' ') WITHIN GROUP(
 ORDER BY
 rmd.test_id
 ) AS test_ids
FROM
 fr_vrarity_matrix_det rmd,
 master_codes mc
WHERE
 mc.code_type IN ( 'REAC', 'NREAC' )
 AND rmd.test_result = mc.code
 AND sysdate BETWEEN mc.eff_date AND nvl(mc.term_date, sysdate + 1)
GROUP BY
 rmd.matrix_id
